sources.snippet: 🛰️ ResearchQwen 2.5-3B-LoRA Compact, domain-expert Q&A for systems researchers. Base model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B Tuning recipe: 4-bit QLoRA with bitsandbytes NF4 quantisation Retriever: FAISS cosine-similarity store for ~33 k document chunks

sources.title: GitHub - chrisipanaque/qwen-lora-finetune: Fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder for ...
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B on your own instruction-response pairs using QLoRA (4-bit quantization + Low-Rank Adaptation). The output is a ~16 MB LoRA adapter that captures your specific code style — shareable, swappable, and applied on top of the base model at inference time.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B QLoRA Fine-tuning Guide - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository provides a complete, production-ready implementation for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B using QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation). QLoRA enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models on consumer-grade GPUs by using 4-bit quantization.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 QLoRA, LoRA, and Full Fine-tuning on Your Computer
sources.snippet: Hugging Face collection: Qwen2.5 With all these sizes, Qwen2.5 offers flexibility across various hardware configurations. The 7B and 14B models are ideal for 24 GB GPUs, and they support efficient fine-tuning with LoRA and QLoRA. For full fine-tuning, smaller models are a better fit.
